version: channels-2 (2026-11-02; the fix round: increments for the overlay and the core-goods pass-through, the X-date gated on a live standoff, the independence ladder as levels, demand-side activity decay, tariff pass-through units, news groups)
source: the policy-channels round's judge (channels/judge/mapping.json, 91 entries, 268 statements), normalized per unit of each trigger by make_channels.py and checked against the judge's statements at every option's default intensity (summed per field, mode and quarter)
units: size_sd in sd_q_1985_2019 of the field (the engine's self.sd); sizes at the option's default intensity x0; scale 'lin' and 'write' statements scale linearly with the particle's realized magnitude or write (x/x0) inside the option's range; 'step'/'fixed' do not. quarters are offsets from the action quarter (for write-triggered channels: from each write, commitments included when executed).

modes.shift: observation at the particle's own A0 draw + delta (delta ~ N(size, soft^2))
modes.hold: observation at the particle's own A0 draw (sign 0, size 0); yields to any write on the field
modes.display: do_last through structural= (satellites only): books, packets and charts; nothing responds
modes.label: observation at a fixed label value (x_oil_cause: 0 demand, 1 supply)

rules.rule: an observation statement pins x_f = A0_f + sum(delta) for its particles; delta ~ N(size * x/x0, soft^2), soft = half the size unless stated (判断值); several channels and actors add on the same field-quarter (AGENT_DESIGN §6.4); on the increment fields (d_ip, d_core) a shift is an increment on the value the quarter's other pins give (P7, P16)

shift / hold (A0 value, yields to any write; several holds are one) / display (do_last through structural=, satellites only; never d_core, and d_unrate / d_rgdp only with P6) / label; an observation wins over a display on one field
no markets-first hold of the E0 core (design a's R1 is not adopted): the stack completes the quarter around each statement
rules.evidence: J01: a +0.5 sd GZ statement gives the same equity impact either way (-1.66% vs -1.84%) but under R1 its activity effect is exactly 0 at every horizon (the cycle module makes IP exogenous in free quarters; IP level -0.22% and unemployment +0.07 pp with E0 free), and with a free Fed R1 imputes a hawkish policy surprise (ff +0.19 sd) that the price puzzle turns into inflation; same-quarter price imputations of big financial bundles are handled by data-level holds (P5) instead

rules.rule: channel yield statements are written on d_y10 (core); d_tp10 and d_y2 appear only as displays
rules.evidence: J02: a d_tp10 observation with a GZ statement in the same quarter collapses to y10 +0.16 sd instead of +0.69 (flight-to-safety association) and drags crude +9.3% through tp10's oil association; written on d_y10 the yield is exact (generalizes design a's R5; design b's choice)

rules.rule: holds carried by the statements where the stack's association contradicts the template's signature: non-energy goods-price statements (tariffs, export controls, fiscal demand-pull, pandemic shortages) hold d_oil; demand-channel IP statements (fiscal, hyperscaler capex) hold d_cpi_goods; labour supply holds d_unrate; institutional and sovereign financial bundles (independence onsets, the court's reversal, the X-date) hold d_cpi_goods, d_cpi_serv and d_oil in their onset quarter
rules.evidence: goods CPI observed drags oil +0.42 sd per sd (tariffs at 5.4 pp: crude +0.94% without the hold); IP observed lowers goods CPI 0.12 sd per sd (design a's stimulus lowers CPI y/y by 0.09 pp at h4); X-date without holds imputes goods CPI +1.0 sd and crude +13% on impact, court-allowed removal goods +0.51 sd and crude +8% (J04)

rules.rule: any write on d_unrate or d_rgdp, in any mode (display included), comes with a d_ip statement or a d_ip hold at A0; the synthesizer's mechanisms on growth fields pin d_ip at B_k's value (a fix the current engine needs regardless of channels)
rules.evidence: design b b08: a d_rgdp display at its own A0 value switches the cycle module off and redraws IP (+0.47 sd mean, 1.8 sd per particle); a d_unrate pin alone +0.40 sd; with d_ip held both are neutral

rules.rule: d_ip statements are increments on the IP the quarter's other pins give: pass 1 completes B_k without the d_ip statements (with the P6 hold at A0 when a growth field is written), pass 2 pins d_ip = pass-1 IP + sum(delta); one extra completion only when some particle has a d_ip statement (common random numbers in both); the inflation pass (P16) follows: the three inflation flows pinned at the quarter's values plus the core-goods increments and the price-puzzle overlay's
rules.evidence: J02: a d_ip pin blocks the other statements' own activity association in its quarter; capex_slash IP level -0.69% one-pass vs -1.37% two-pass (the GZ +1.5 sd credit channel kept); in a busy tree different actors' IP tails and GZ statements meet in the same particle-quarter

rules.rule: statements on level-bounded fields scale with the room to the historical extremes, per particle on the start-of-quarter level: falls x clip((level - p01)/(p50 - p01), 0, 1), rises x clip((p99 - level)/(p99 - p50), 0, 1); p01/p50/p99: GZ 0.65/1.50/4.71, Baa-10y 1.01/2.09/3.99, unemployment 3.50/5.70/10.27 (design a's R4; design b's half-distance-to-bound dropped)
rules.evidence: today's QE_PATHS at the root (GZ 0.93) return 10-year +9.9 sd, Treasury -38%, crude +27% (reproduced, J03); room-scaled QE: 10-year -0.28 sd, equity +2.0%, Treasury +1.1%

rules.rule: |sum delta| <= 3 sd per field-quarter for in-history channels; templates beyond history (pandemic, Taiwan blockade, X-date) keep their sizes, are flagged 超出可测历史, are exempt from the cap and report the adapter's saturation notes; summed policy-uncertainty (TPU) intensity <= 3 units a quarter over all actors

when the adapter's rarity_detail percentile of a cluster's pins exceeds the 99th, the channel deltas (not the actors' levers) are scaled back together until it does not, except beyond-history templates
channels never write d_ff (the Fed actor's), asset prices, valuations, anchors or states (D1, R6); rate responses in templates (G01, G04, G35) stay the Fed actor's decisions

d_usd is written only where the template states the dollar (G08 QE, G11 CNY, G19 China stimulus, G29 independence, the blockade's safe haven, the X-date); elsewhere the adapter's own dollar treatment stands (G05's dollar is 由叙事写明: no statement by default)

no channel on hazards that partition the model's own tails (oil disruption, GPR episode, financial accident): their event particles already carry the model's own draw; only nature's pandemic (a pinned fact or stress mode, not a partition) and the accounts' X-date fact carry channels
rules.evidence: design b's OIL x4 / GEO x2 on the event branch would count the tail twice (tree.apply_nature takes B_k's own tail particles; actors.hazard_payload's oil_z is not applied)

rules.rule: news statements (uncertainty and GZ components, EPU / sentiment / supply-chain / export displays, QE's GZ and dollar) of the k-th consecutive quarter of the same news group (an actor's moves in one direction: the two tariff escalations, the two substitute authorities) by the same actor are scaled by 1/k; flows (pass-through per realized pp, oil per z, spending, IP per write, drifts, QE's yield) never habituate; standing-fact level statements fire once per onset (re-choosing a live fact writes nothing new)
rules.evidence: design a: the B2 x 80 mock chose tariff_up_large every quarter: +24 sd of GZ unhabituated, +1.5 sd with 1/k

rules.rule: offsets > 0 go into a per-particle consequence queue held in a private state key ('_channel_queue', carried by resampling and by the adapter's roll like every '_' key): pending deltas and holds by field and due quarter; later choices never cancel queued consequences (a reversal writes its own opposite statements and the two net); commitments stay cancellable and fire only when executed; queued entries are discrete state for node distances only through their effect on the draws (design b's per-particle queue, not design a's node-level tails, because non-branching actors' options are allocated per particle)

the core-goods pass-through (protocol core_goods) and the price-puzzle overlay are increments on the quarter's inflation: after the other completions the three inflation flows (services, goods, core) are pinned at their values plus the increments, so neither erases another action's inflation effect and the overlay's fields stay open to the synthesizer
rules.evidence: the review: with the overlay pinned at A0 + h.e, an oil escalation's same-quarter inflation was 0.000 (+0.17 sd core silent), CPI y/y h4 +0.36 -> -0.03

rules.rule: demand-side activity statements (fiscal multipliers, tax cuts, consolidation, hyperscaler capex, uncertainty and geopolitical tails, China's stimulus) carry decay 8: the pulse is given back over the 8 quarters after its last one; supply-side ones (tariff efficiency, retaliation, supply chains, oil, labour supply, the blockade) stay in the level, documented
rules.evidence: the review: the cycle module draws IP growth from history in quarters without a statement, so a pulse never reversed (stimulus_large IP +0.62% at h8 and h40); Ramey 2019, Gilchrist-Zakrajsek 2012: multiplier and credit-shock output effects fade within 2-4 years

rules.rule: the X-date event fires once per particle, the first quarter its TGA is below the floor while its debt-limit standoff is live (Congress kept the standoff through the deadline); never in the base-rate tree (no channels there, P20)

the independence rungs are levels of one institutional shock (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 of G29_full): a rung's onset writes only the increment over the highest rung already live for the particle (an attempt after a nominee adds 0.25 of the full template), and the services drift is the highest live rung's, while it lives (no 8-quarter cap; the rung's exit hazard ends it)

channels run in the agent tree only: the model tree is the model's own distribution and the base-rate tree draws history's actions at history's frequencies, whose average effects the model's residuals already contain (applying the channels there counted them twice); an agent tree at c = 0 pools exactly the base rates and has none either
rules.evidence: the review: base-rate tree with channels on, GZ 3.02 vs 1.66 off at quarter 20, unemployment 4.65 vs 4.01

rules.rule: a d_y10 statement brings the stack's growth-news association (lower yields with lower output and oil): QE's yield statement alone lowers crude 0.9%, its dollar and GZ raise it 0.9% each; documented, not held (the template states no oil effect)

intensity: options with a magnitude scale linearly in the particle's realized magnitude or write inside the option's range (pp of tariff; % GDP; mb/d and composite z; capex plan %; days; d_bs pp), never beyond the template's range

documented asymmetries: tariff cuts pass through at half the price effect of increases (output symmetric); QT at half of QE per unit; capex raises add no spread narrowing (G06); a capex digestion (capex_cut) carries +0.15 sd GZ per -10% of plan, the 2001-02 slash G06's bust +1.5 sd x |x|/35 (cap +2)

discrete domains take fixed fractions of the template's central footprint, monotone in the domain's order (CI): independence 0.25 (pressure_public) / 0.5 (nominate_dovish) / 0.75 (attempt_removal) / 1.0 (courts.allow_removal) of G29 = {d_y10 +0.8, d_usd -1.0, d_gz +0.3, displays tp10 +1.5, EPU +2.4, infexp_lr +1.0; services drift +0.15 sd a quarter while the fact lives}

policy uncertainty is a news step per decision in EPU-sd units (GZ +0.25, IP -0.015 at q1-3, EPU +1, sentiment -0.7 per unit): tariff_up_small 0.6, tariff_up_large 1.2 (escalation-quarter footprint), deal and negotiate_truce -0.5, replace_* +0.3, accept_lapse -0.3, retaliation 0 (no footprint), export controls 0, court rulings 0; monotonicity across small/large is tested, continuity at 1.5 pp is not required (different news)
status-quo options have zero intensity (neutrality) except accept_lapse (it writes a real -3 pp) and uphold_protection (a reversal, only after a live removal attempt)
synthesizer: channels run in B_k before the synthesizer sees the cluster; its request lists them in a new section 模板通道：已由代码写入（模板与文献） with field, sign, size and quarters
a mechanism may not shift a field a channel wrote for a cause in the same cluster (the field joins the cluster's written set for mechanisms); mechanism signs must agree with the channel's

a lever whose channel ran has channel class 'template' (weights as 'moderate': w 0.5, cap 1.5; refused in normal states): G1 no longer fires for that lever's inertness; mechanisms from it remain only beyond the template's support (beyond_history), in regimes (ZLB, core > 4%, last-quarter stress) or for a channel-less standing fact

partitions stay allowed on every axis including channel-shifted fields (a partition is a region of B_k's own standardized distribution; a mean shift does not change its mass): axis_list(written=) receives the actors' lever writes only; the request marks channel-shifted axes as already shifted
capex_slash's x1.5 tilt of the fin-conditions partition is retired (the channel writes d_gz)

from quarter 5 (synth_depth 4), in the mock and with the synthesizer off, channels carry the whole effect: a channel-covered lever acts the same in quarter 3 and quarter 30; the default partition is unchanged
protocol.response_table_and_G08: with channels on, tree.RESPONSE_TABLE is not applied (the transfers channel states the activity on d_ip and shows the table's +2.1% per pp on d_cons_goods as a display: one application) and tree.QE_PATHS is replaced by the G08 channel (d_y10, d_gz room-scaled, d_usd as observations; d_tp10, d_y2 displays); both stay as the fallback with channels off (TreeSettings.channels in the tree hash), so P14 snapshots reproduce exactly, QE_PATHS' low-GZ hazard included (documented)
protocol.neutrality: status-quo options and prior-only bin actors write nothing; the model tree masks non-instrument actors at the status quo, so no channel fires and its leaf mixture still reproduces the model; the base-rate tree applies channels to the options its priors draw (history's actions with their generic consequences: say so on the honesty card); channels are code, so the LLM weight c = 0 neutrality is unaffected
protocol.application_order: in B_k, per particle: actor levers (unchanged) -> due queue entries -> this quarter's channel statements (sum of shifts on the particle's A0 draws; holds; displays; labels) -> room rule -> caps and joint rarity -> completion (two passes when any d_ip statement is present) -> synthesizer (first 4 quarters) -> children

triggers.write: a realized lever write per particle (d_tariff point; d_transfers, d_deficit, d_perstax shifts; the hyperscaler fallback's d_itinv shift; d_bs; d_lf): statements per unit of the write, offsets from the write's quarter; commitments fire their write's statements only when executed (as_committed), so a cancelled phase stops its channel; custom options get the write channels of the levers they write and no news statements
triggers.oil_z: the oil-supply composite sum z per particle (SPR, OPEC+, belligerents, blockade): d_oil at the composite's own elasticity + the existing d_metals_oil signature + the activity lag; the existing supply label rule |sum z| >= 0.5 stays
triggers.option: a chosen option without a lever (facts-only options): news statements at onset
triggers.fact: a standing fact's flow statements each quarter it lives (at most 8 quarters per onset), level statements once when it turns on; the fact's exit hazard ends them
triggers.cond: conditions on start-of-quarter state per particle (tight market s_unrate < 4.5) or on live facts (relief after a standoff, reversal after a removal attempt)
triggers.surprise: the price-puzzle overlay: each particle's Fed surprise e = pinned d_ff - its own A0 d_ff (see price_puzzle)

core_goods.rule: every non-energy goods-price statement (tariffs, export controls, the blockade's shortages, fiscal demand-pull, the pandemic's reopening shortages) is a core-goods shock: core CPI gets +0.4775 x the goods move (goods weight 0.382 / core weight 0.80, all of it in core goods), less the stack's own goods->core pass-through (0.070 of the goods move, measured), as an increment on the quarter's core with goods and services held at their values (a d_core observation alone imputes services +0.82 sd per sd)
core_goods.basis: d_core loads 0.137 on headline and 0.589 on services (G0): a goods statement moved core by 0.07 of its size, against 0.48 when the shock is in core goods (ARW 2019, Cavallo et al. 2021: tariff pass-through is to core goods prices); weights BLS relative importance (判断值 rounding)

increment_fields.d_ip: P7: an increment on the IP the quarter's other pins give (second completion)
increment_fields.d_core: the core-goods pass-through: an increment on the quarter's core (inflation pass, with goods and services held), together with the price-puzzle overlay's increments

ladder.rule: the independence rungs are levels of one institutional shock (0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 / 1.0 of G29_full): a rung's onset writes only the increment over the highest rung already live for the particle (an attempt after a nominee adds 0.25 of the full template), and the services drift is the highest live rung's, while it lives (no 8-quarter cap; the rung's exit hazard ends it)
ladder.basis: the review: climbed in sequence the rungs summed to 2.5 x G29_full (y10 +2.0 sd, dollar -2.5 sd)

G05 d_exports - (escalation quarters mean -0.9 sd); display

evidence.irf: +50bp do vs placebo (CRN): core CPI y/y +0.025 (q2), +0.074 (q4), +0.097 (q6), +0.090 (q8), +0.060 (q12); unemployment +0.065 (q8), +0.101 (q16); tree.transmission ff_irf core q4-8 +0.091, puzzle True (design a a08; design b b01)
evidence.source: the lag coefficients, not the impact ordering: holding oil or the E0 core on impact, holding oil 8 quarters or switching the cycle module off leaves core +0.095-0.097 at q6 (design a a09)
evidence.spiral: J07 (N 2000, CRN, extra do-pins on each particle's A0 draw): +50bp whenever core > 4%: core +0.35 pp at q16, +0.55 at q40, unemployment +2.46 pp at q40; the menu's hike_75plus gate as written (core >= 4% or Michigan >= 4.5%, u < 5%): core +0.60 at q8, +0.89 at q16, 10 pp of extra tightening by q40; design a without the u < 5% leg: +42 pp, core +2.04, u +8.1 at q80; design b hawk (2.5) minus passive (0.7): core +1.17 pp at q20, +2.04 at q40, non-finite particles from q60
evidence.mock_runs: the 80-quarter mock snapshots show no spiral because the mock Fed takes the pooled prior's modal bin (design a a06), but over q30-80 the agent and base-rate trees' core medians run 4.07% and 4.32% against the model tree's 3.32% (design b b06c; suggestive, beam 2)
evidence.overlay: J07: the three-field deconvolved kernel keeps core within ±0.01 pp through q16 under +50bp-if-core>4 (two fields: +0.07 at q16, +0.26 at q40) and +0.04 at q16 under the gate rule (two fields +0.25); s_core_yoy is computed from d_core (rollout.Stepper.roll), so d_core must be in the kernel (design a; design b's two-field kernel leaves the d_core loading)
evidence.gate_fix: J07: requiring core >= 3.5% on the Michigan leg cuts the gate's firing from 33% to 22% of particle-quarters and the extra tightening by q40 from 10.0 to 6.9 pp

overlay_spec.kernel: deconvolved once per adapter identity (cached like tree._TRANSMISSION) by a lockstep CRN pass: a +1 pp do surprise at k = 0, then at each k the correction that sets the three flows' net response (the surprise's propagation plus the earlier corrections' own) to zero; reference values per 1 pp of surprise below (design a a13, replicated in J07)
overlay_spec.active: only while transmission().ff_irf.puzzle is true (it switches itself off once the model role re-identifies u_ff; otherwise it would cancel a right-signed response too)
overlay_spec.scope: particles whose Fed decision is pinned (agent trees, the LLM Fed and the mock Fed alike); e = 0 for prior-only bin actors, so the model tree, the base-rate tree's instruments and c = 0 neutrality are exact
overlay_spec.attribution: component 价格之谜修正 in §7.7
overlay_spec.honesty_card: 价格之谜已中和：美联储意外加息或降息对通胀的作用设为零（不是文献的去通胀效应），等待模型重新识别；在此之前，通胀较高时一个按通胀加息的美联储会过度收紧（失业率上升，通胀不因此下降）
